items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Because his banjo, the secretary of the union here used to play banjo with him.

ctx.x: Your girl's calling. She's out there. Girl's calling. She's on there. Have you ever heard that he was around San Jose? Who? Wait, wait, wait, wait.
He wasn't San Jose before he moved down there. Before then. Because his banjo, the secretary of the union here used to play banjo with him. He died about two years ago. Forbes. Yeah, Forbes.
